verdict.rationale: Official docs explicitly document three embed types (inline, popup, floating) with code snippets, e.g. `Calendly.initInlineWidget({url: myLink})`, and describe replacing the scheduling_url to initialize the embed. This directly matches the story's ask for a documented embed snippet across inline/popup/floating widgets. Missing for 10: no independent/hands-on developer report confirming ease of use of the embed snippets beyond first-party docs.
